_doc: Prompts for this channel's music library (Drive Music-Library/bharat/). Generate with scripts/lyria_music.py; PLAYBOOK §12.1.
common: Instrumental only: no vocals, no choir, no humming, no spoken words, no vocal samples, and no pads or synths that sound like voices or a choir: sustained sounds come from bowed strings, piano, electric piano, organ-free analogue synths and electronic hum. This is a documentary underscore that plays under a narrator's voice: no lead melody in the speech range, no sudden loud hits or long silences, a steady overall level from start to finish, clean cinematic mix, wide stereo. Make it about three minutes long. It ends with a final held chord or note that decays naturally, never an abrupt cut.

tracks.title: Dawn of an Empire
tracks.use: Cold opens and the first chapter: wonder at the scale of what was built
tracks.prompt: Cinematic wonder. 76 BPM, D major. Warm sustained strings, a soft bansuri flute phrase now and then (low in the mix), gentle piano, a deep warm pad. Feels like the first light over a great Indian city or a steel works at dawn. Spacious and proud, never loud.
tracks.brief: cinematic wonder, warm strings, occasional bansuri, spacious

tracks.title: Ambition
tracks.use: A founder's dream, the early plans, the first risk
tracks.prompt: Hopeful and determined. 92 BPM, G major. A steady piano ostinato, strings that build slowly, a soft tabla pattern low in the mix, a light pulse. The feeling of someone daring to build something that has never been built in India before.
tracks.brief: hopeful determined, piano ostinato, building strings, soft tabla

tracks.title: Against the Odds
tracks.use: Opposition, doubt, the empire that said it could not be done
tracks.prompt: Serious tension. 82 BPM, C minor. Low string ostinato, a heartbeat-like low drum, dark synth pad, occasional deep percussion swells. Restrained and cinematic, the stakes rising.
tracks.brief: serious tension, low string ostinato, heartbeat drum, restrained

tracks.title: Loss
tracks.use: A setback, a death, a failure, a tragedy told with dignity
tracks.prompt: Grief told with dignity. 60 BPM, A minor. Solo cello, slow piano, a soft sustained string pad, a distant sarangi-like bowed line very low in the mix. Quiet and human. No percussion.
tracks.brief: dignified grief, solo cello, slow piano, no percussion

tracks.title: The Rise
tracks.use: The comeback: momentum, growth, the factory running at full tilt
tracks.prompt: Rising momentum. 110 BPM, E minor moving to G major. Driving string ostinato, cinematic percussion with dhol and tabla blended into orchestral drums, brass swells. Builds from a quiet start to a strong confident peak, then holds and resolves.
tracks.brief: rising momentum, driving strings, dhol and tabla with orchestral drums, builds

tracks.title: Built on Bharat
tracks.use: The climax and the emotional landing: what it means for India today
tracks.prompt: Dignified pride. 84 BPM, D major. Full warm orchestra, a shehnai melody in the middle section (not throughout), broad strings, timpani rolls kept soft. Proud but never jingoistic, emotional and uplifting, resolves with a full warm chord.
tracks.brief: dignified pride, warm orchestra, shehnai section, uplifting, resolved

tracks.title: Old Bombay
tracks.use: Archive photos, the 1900s to the 1950s, nostalgia
tracks.prompt: Gentle nostalgia. 72 BPM, F major. Soft upright piano, light strings, a sitar playing a simple phrase now and then, a faint warm vinyl-like texture. Like turning the pages of an old family album in a Bombay home.
tracks.brief: gentle nostalgia, soft piano, light strings, occasional sitar

tracks.title: New India
tracks.use: Modern chapters: technology, payments, space, scale today
tracks.prompt: Modern and optimistic. 104 BPM, A major. An electronic pulse with soft synth arpeggios, tabla loops blended with a clean modern beat, uplifting string pads. Confident and forward-moving, a country building at scale.
tracks.brief: modern optimistic electronic pulse with tabla, uplifting

tracks.title: The Shop Floor
tracks.use: Workers, furnaces, mills, railways, the heat and grit of labour
tracks.prompt: Gritty and human. 88 BPM, D minor. Industrial percussion like hammers on metal blended with low drums, a deep drone, low strings, a soft distant flute line. The heat and weight of a steel mill and the people in it. Heavy but not aggressive.
tracks.brief: gritty industrial percussion, low strings, heavy but not aggressive

tracks.title: Countdown
tracks.use: Suspense before a launch, a vote, a decision, a first run
tracks.prompt: Suspense before a launch. 96 BPM, B minor. A ticking pulse, low synth bass, sustained rising strings, soft cinematic percussion that builds tension steadily, held under control, ends on a held chord waiting for the moment.
tracks.brief: suspense ticking building, held under control

tracks.title: Legacy
tracks.use: The outro and the end screen, reflection on legacy
tracks.prompt: Warm reflection. 68 BPM, C major. Bansuri flute and soft piano over a warm string pad, slow and peaceful. A sense of legacy and gratitude. Ends on a soft held chord.
tracks.brief: warm reflection, bansuri and piano, peaceful, soft ending

tracks.title: Shorts Bed
tracks.use: Vertical Shorts: a fast story beat
tracks.prompt: Make this one about one minute long. Starts immediately with no intro: a cinematic pulse with strings, tabla and modern drums, 108 BPM, E minor, energetic and proud, a lift at thirty seconds, ends on a held chord.
tracks.brief: energetic cinematic immediate start, tabla and strings, about one minute
